t: The Tornado Moment: Building a Resumable Demo That Survives a Page Reload
s: This article details refactoring Pipulate's codebase to enhance branding and consolidate static assets, focusing on creating a controlled demo experience and solving page reload state persistence with a database-backed bookmarking system.
sub: Branding codebase with custom names (e.g., pipulate.js)
Consolidating static assets (JS/CSS) into logical groups
Implementing resumable demo state persistence via database bookmarking
Iterative development with AI assistant for code refactoring
